name: InstaWP
description:
Use Claude to launch WordPress sites, build and manage an entire fleet of sites. 

Ask Claude to:

- Create a fresh WordPress site in seconds
- Clone a site for staging
- Create backups before risky changes
- Upgrade or roll back PHP and WordPress versions
- Pull diagnostics when something goes wrong (white screen of death)

You can start by creating sandbox sites and then seamlessly upgrade them to production grade quality. 


InstaWP operates at two levels.

At the account level, Claude can manage sites, backups, plans, teams, versions, and diagnostics.

At the site level, Claude can work directly inside any connected WordPress site — without requiring a separate MCP connector for every site, so you can:

- Create and edit posts and pages
- Build and update Gutenberg blocks or Elementor pages
- Upload and attach media
- Manage taxonomies and custom fields
- Install and configure plugins and themes
- Read debug logs and diagnose problems

Security and control

Account-level MCP access is disabled by default and connects securely using OAuth, on site level, you can selectively enable access and go deep to enable execute/files/db access.

_published_faq.name: How do I add InstaWP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add InstaWP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app.instawp.io/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the InstaWP MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: InstaWP lists 13 MCP tools, including change_plan, create_backup, create_site, delete_site, get_billing_info, get_site_details, get_site_mcp, list_backups, list_sites, run_site_tool, toggle_site_setting, and update_php.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to InstaWP?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to InstaWP in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
InstaWP requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
InstaWP is developed by InstaWP Inc. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
